description: The file defines a CalendarHandler class that manages calendar events in an Android application. It includes data classes for requests and records, an external interface for data source interactions, and an internal implementation that interacts with Android's CalendarProvider to read and add calendar events. The class provides methods to handle retrieving events and adding new events, with JSON-based parameter parsing.

classes.name: CalendarEventsRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request to retrieve calendar events, with start time, end time, and limit.

classes.name: CalendarAddRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request to add a calendar event, including title, time range, all-day flag, location, notes, and calendar identification.

classes.name: CalendarEventRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a calendar event record with identifier, title, ISO start/end times, all-day flag, location, and calendar title.

classes.name: CalendarDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for calendar data sources, including permission checks, fetching events, and adding events.

classes.name: SystemCalendarDataSource
classes.description: Implementation of CalendarDataSource that interacts with Android's CalendarProvider.

classes.name: CalendarHandler
classes.description: Main class that processes JSON requests to retrieve or add calendar events, utilizing the data source.

methods.name: handleCalendarEvents
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON parameters to retrieve calendar events, returning the result as a JSON string or error.

methods.name: handleCalendarAdd
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON parameters to add a calendar event, returning the created event data or error.

methods.name: parseEventsRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters into a CalendarEventsRequest object, with default values if missing.

methods.name: parseAddRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters into a CalendarAddRequest object.

methods.name: parseISO
methods.description: Parses an ISO 8601 string into an Instant object.

methods.name: eventJson
methods.description: Converts a CalendarEventRecord into a JsonObject for JSON serialization.
